policy: A quarantined provider stays registered, synced, mirrored, and audited; only its public site projection is withheld. Quarantine never deletes provider state or mirrored bytes. Lifting an entry requires resolving its recorded defect or redistribution restriction and republishing. An entry is justified by a defective public projection or documented redistribution restriction, not by incomplete acquisition, which is tracked in catalog/source-coverage instead.
